title: Correct hero circular wrap, breakpoint jump, and mobile clipping
outcome: Hero copy follows a shared circular boundary around the enlarged sphere, the sphere resizes continuously across desktop widths, and hero content fits mobile viewports.
acceptance: At 390px viewport width, hero copy and actions fit within the shell without clipping.
Desktop text contours align with the sphere's center and radius, with readable clearance from the animated glow.
Resizing between 1379px and 1380px does not nearly double the sphere diameter.

completion.summary: Improved the hero composition with sphere-based text wrapping, stronger responsive typography, softer unclipped glow, continuous desktop scaling, correct mobile containment, and robust motion controls.
